# Federation 2399 Application Menu candidate v6

Issue: [#175](https://github.com/mshamblin5150-code/clinical-calendar/issues/175)

Status: **Pending physical SM-X920 review.** This package contains
deterministic Flutter evidence only. It does not record a signed-device
installation or infer a maintainer acceptance decision under #139.

Federation 2399 continues to declare **1536 by 1024** as its exact landscape
golden viewport. Renderer contract:
`federation-2399-owned-responsive-console-v6`.

## Repair evidence

- The catalog-owned `CanonicalDeltaMark` is now the sole Federation 2399
  Application Menu trigger. The competing grid glyph and separately exposed
  decorative delta are absent.
- The trigger retains the production Application Menu callback and exposes one
  deterministic `Open menu` button semantic with tap action.
- Production interaction tests open the complete Application Menu in
  landscape, portrait, Standard, and Enhanced modes. Separate tests exercise
  keyboard Enter, switch-style Space activation after focus traversal, and
  accessibility-service semantic activation.
- The accepted layered burgundy chassis, destination housings, Needs Attention
  composition, Academic Assignment workflow, 200-percent behavior, and
  canonical delta asset source remain intact.
- Containment Drone renderer files, protected raster assets, geometry, hashes,
  and accepted goldens are unchanged.

## Files

- `approved-concept-landscape.png`: untouched approved issue #114 concept.
- `runtime-landscape-1536x1024.png`: deterministic landscape production shell
  with fictional data.
- `landscape-concept-vs-runtime.png`: labeled equal-size concept/runtime
  comparison; neither source file is modified.
- `runtime-portrait-900x1440.png`: deterministic portrait recomposition.
- `runtime-portrait-200-percent-900x1440.png`: deterministic initial portrait
  state at 200-percent text.
- `runtime-portrait-200-percent-scrolled-900x1440.png`: lower 200-percent state
  proving the live console regions remain reachable.

All runtime captures use fictional data. None is a physical-device capture.

## Physical Android-tablet acceptance

State: **Pending.** The repaired candidate must be installed as a signed
private-release upgrade and repeated on the Samsung SM-X920 with
original-resolution screenshot/UI-tree evidence. The maintainer must then
explicitly accept Federation 2399 or keep it Pending on #139. Automated tests
and this proof package cannot satisfy that gate.
